about: Example boxes the current spec cannot express yet (F73 example set). Kept as briefs; each becomes a draft once the spec has what it needs.

waiting.name: Treasury Turtles
waiting.brief: Demo example 7. Tokenized T-bills, slow and steady: 100 turtles, open art, priced in USDY, holders paid in USDY and SHELL. 90 days.
needs: USDY on the curated list, after a legal review (ref. F61 TB1)
Holder payouts beyond the Demo: built for testnet, then a legal review for mainnet (ref. slice S14)
waiting.nearestToday: Priced in ETH with burn on both sides; the T-bill story waits for USDY.

waiting.name: Nested Nests
waiting.brief: Demo example 9. Boxes in boxes: 50 nests, open art, priced in another box's token (e.g. HOOT) so the buyers' side burns HOOT; sellers' fees pay holders in NEST; royalties 2.5% with the fees. 60 days.
needs: Another box's token on the curated list, a graduated box (ref. slice S12)
Holder payouts beyond the Demo: built for testnet, then a legal review for mainnet (ref. slice S14)
waiting.nearestToday: Priced in ETH with 'Burn FIT' on the buyers' side and royalties with the fees.
